name: labs/allenneuraldynamics__runze-control
title: Runze ZSB-SY01B multichannel syringe pump
intro: Runze ZSB-SY01B multichannel syringe pump, adapted from allenneuraldynamics/runze-control. It reads `position_steps`, `position_percent`, `position_ul`, `firmware_version` and 4 more; runs `move_to_percent`, `aspirate`, `dispense`, `select_valve_port` and 3 more. `move_to_percent`: move the plunger to an absolute position in percent of full travel. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
